SYNTHETIC TEST JOB DESCRIPTION — Full Stack TypeScript Engineer
Company: Example Fullstack Labs (fictional)
Location: Boston / Remote, United States

Responsibilities and selection priorities
Build customer-facing React and Next.js interfaces together with Node.js REST API endpoints and PostgreSQL storage. Implement accessible form workflows, query optimization and integration tests. Ship through GitHub Actions CI/CD and Docker. Select work showing both UI and backend delivery rather than unrelated algorithms exercises.

Required qualifications
- TypeScript
- React
- Next.js
- Node.js
- PostgreSQL
- REST API
- GitHub Actions

Preferred, not mandatory
- GraphQL

Applications are assessed on demonstrated work. Candidates may apply without preferred tools. Do not claim skills you have not used.
